# Regulatory Overlay

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay`](gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RegulatoryOverlay>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The reified, time-scoped fact that a specific regulation applies over a place — imposed by an authority. Covers zoning, protected areas, restricted airspace, sanctions, tax/electoral districts, postal zones, civil-time zones, and similar legally-defined spatial overlays. Distinct from [`JurisdictionTenure`](gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md) (governance/sovereignty): an overlay is about a specific regulatory regime applied over a geographic area. Links to [`RightsStatement`](gmeow-RightsStatement.md) for the deontic rules (permissions, prohibitions, duties) that hold within it. Contested overlays coexist as multiple standpoint-indexed instances, never collapsing to a single winner ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay`](gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
